    Profile

    Miuna is a descendant from the People of Ku, who forged Excalibur. Miuna inherited her father's talent as well, making her an excellent blacksmith. She can be quite emotional, but once you've earned her trust, she's a reliable ally who will never betray you. Miuna looks up to Zain and Cadanova like older brothers, since they often visited her father.

    Origin: Slothstein
    Gender: Female
    Height: 154cm
    Weight: 40kg
    Birthday: Apr 21
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Flame King
    Likes: Anvil sparks
    Hobbies: Gathering ores
